20261122-physics-h3-1.goal: Apply principles of For projectile wey dem shoot from to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h3-1.material: [Advanced 2D mechanics] For projectile wey dem shoot from ground with initial speed v₀ for angle θ with di horizontal, di maximum horizontal range R na R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. If no air resistance dey, wetin be di launch angle θ wey go make di horizontal range maximum, and wetin be di other launch angle wey get di same horizontal distance as launch angle 30°?
20261122-physics-h3-1.thinking.0: For projectile wey dem shoot from
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: [Advanced 2D mechanics] For projectile wey dem shoot from ground with initial speed v₀ for angle θ with di horizontal, di maximum horizontal range R na R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. If no air resistance dey, wetin be di launch angle θ wey go make di horizontal range maximum, and wetin be di other launch angle wey get di same horizontal distance as launch angle 30°?
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Di condition wey go make $\sin 2\theta$ maximum na $2\theta = 90^\circ \implies \theta = 45^\circ$. Also, because $\sin(2 \times 30^\circ) = \sin 60^\circ = \sin 120^\circ = \sin(2 \times 60^\circ)$, di range dey equal for angles wey di sum na $90^\circ$ ($60^\circ$).
20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.o.o0: Maximum launch angle: 45°,  same-distance launch angle: 60°

20261122-physics-h3-1.s.s1.o.o3: Maximum launch angle: 30°,  same-distance launch angle: 90°

20261122-physics-h3-2.title: Wetin be di decisive wave property
20261122-physics-h3-2.topic: Wetin be di decisive wave property
20261122-physics-h3-2.goal: Apply principles of Wetin be di decisive wave property to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h3-2.material: Wetin be di decisive wave property wey make LASER beam fit travel thin and strong without spreading far, unlike incandescent lamp or sunlight?
20261122-physics-h3-2.thinking.0: Wetin be di decisive wave property
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.prompt: Wetin be di decisive wave property wey make LASER beam fit travel thin and strong without spreading far, unlike incandescent lamp or sunlight?
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.explain: Laser na light wey dem produce through stimulated emission, di wavelengths of all di photons wey dem emit dey match extremely well (monochromatic), and di phase of di wave match perfectly (coherent), so e get excellent straightness and focusability.
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.hint.0: Na light wey stimulated emission amplify.
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.hint.1: Di phase and frequency dey perfectly aligned.
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.o.o0: Excellent coherence and monochromaticity, where di wavelength and phase of all photons match perfectly
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.o.o1: Because di speed of light dey 10 times faster than ordinary light
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.o.o2: Because laser na charged particle beam
20261122-physics-h3-2.s.s1.o.o3: Because e fit travel only inside vacuum
